decks.notes: This deck focuses on quick, aggressive plays using low-cost creatures and spells to control the game. The key strategy is to keep up a steady stream of threats while disrupting the opponent's plans with counterspells and bounce effects. By efficiently managing resources and leveraging card advantage, this Mono Blue Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on quickly putting artifacts onto the battlefield to enable powerful synergies and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. Cards like Thoughtcast and Ichor Wellspring help draw into more resources, while cards like Galvanic Blast provide efficient removal for opponent's threats. By utilizing a mix of artifact creatures and spells, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize. The mana base of artifact lands and various bridges supports the deck's affinity strategy.

This Mono Blue Aggro deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent while utilizing card draw and control spells to maintain tempo. It includes low cost creatures like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent, along with disruptive spells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disrupt their plays with counterspells, allowing for a swift victory by controlling the board and consistently attacking.

The focus of the deck lies in utilizing counterspells and card draw to control the game, while also leveraging graveyard interaction with cards like Cryptic Serpent and Tolarian Terror. Murmuring Mystic provides additional value by creating bird tokens, while Lórien Revealed allows for card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while developing a strong board presence with creatures and efficient spells. It is designed to outlast and outmaneuver opponents through a combination of control elements and threats, ultimately leading to victory through attrition and strategic decision-making.

This deck focuses on quickly building up powerful creatures by attaching multiple auras to them, enhancing their abilities and making them difficult to deal with. By utilizing cards like Rancor, Ethereal Armor, and Armadillo Cloak, players can create a formidable threat that can quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck also includes cards like Abundant Growth and Utopia Sprawl to help fix mana and ensure a smooth curve. With a mix of protection, evasion, and power boosts, this deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain momentum throughout the game.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifact creatures and using them to deal damage and control the board. By utilizing a combination of cheap artifacts and mana-efficient spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and efficient removal. The deck also includes cards that can draw extra cards and recycle artifacts from the graveyard to maintain its aggression and card advantage throughout the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Burning-Tree Emissary and Clockwork Percussionist, along with efficient burn spells such as Chain Lightning and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to bring the opponent's life total down rapidly. With cards like Goblin Bushwhacker and Rally at the Hornburg, the deck can also create strong board presence and pump up its creatures for even more damage. Overall, this deck is designed to win quickly and decisively through a combination of creature aggression and direct damage.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play powerful late-game threats, such as Maelstrom Colossus and Ulamog's Crusher. It uses Urza's Tower, Urza's Mine, and Urza's Power Plant to assemble the Urzatron, generating a large amount of colorless mana. This allows the deck to control the board early on with cards like Candy Trail and Barrels of Blasting Jelly, and then overwhelm the opponent with big creatures later in the game. The deck also utilizes cards like Ancient Stirrings and Crop Rotation to find key pieces and maintain consistent mana production.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through card advantage, removal, and counterspells while utilizing the powerful synergy of Ephemerate to repeatedly blink value creatures like Mulldrifter and Archaeomancer. By consistently generating value with these creatures and spells, the deck seeks to outlast and outmaneuver opponents, gradually gaining incremental advantages until securing victory. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Skred and Counterspell helps to disrupt opponent's strategies and maintain control of the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent through a combination of burn spells and aggressive creatures. The deck utilizes cards like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast to deal direct damage to the opponent while also utilizing creatures like Kessig Flamebreather and Guttersnipe to chip away at their life total. Faithless Looting helps to filter through the deck and find the necessary burn spells, while cards like Grab the Prize and Highway Robbery provide additional ways to deal damage. Overall, the deck aims to end the game quickly through a mix of direct damage and creature aggression.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells and card draw, while also using Tolarian Terror and Lórien Revealed as win conditions. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce, while also utilizing card draw spells like Brainstorm and Deep Analysis to maintain card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Cryptic Serpent and Sneaky Snacker provide additional threats to close out the game. Cards like Contaminated Aquifer and Sleep of the Dead help to control the opponent's board while Deem Inferior and Abandon Attachments disrupt their resources.

This Mono Black Aggro deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to pump up Bloodthrone Vampire and Mortician Beetle, while also using cards like Carrion Feeder and Infestation Sage for additional value. The deck includes spells like Rite of Consumption and Village Rites to maintain card advantage and finish off opponents quickly. Shambling Ghast and Nezumi Linkbreaker provide additional creature options, while cards like Supernatural Stamina and Unearth help to protect and recur key creatures. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive creature plays and efficient sacrifices.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly using aggressive red creatures and burn spells. By playing low-cost creatures like Burning-Tree Emissary and Goblin Bushwhacker, combined with cheap removal like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to deal damage fast and efficiently. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Rally at the Hornburg and Clockwork Percussionist helps to maintain pressure on the opponent while providing some card advantage. Overall, this deck is designed to be fast-paced and relentless in its pursuit of victory through aggressive gameplay.

The main idea of this deck revolves around controlling the game through counterspells and card draw, while utilizing cheap spells to enable the powerful Delve mechanic of cards like Cryptic Serpent. The deck aims to efficiently disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence with creatures like Murmuring Mystic and Tolarian Terror. The inclusion of bounce spells like Sleep of the Dead and Deem Inferior adds an extra layer of control, while key finishers like Lórien Revealed and Azure Fleet Admiral help close out the game.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy by utilizing powerful Elf creatures and mana-producing creatures to ramp up quickly. The deck focuses on generating a large board presence and utilizing cards like Timberwatch Elf and Avenging Hunter to buff and attack with strong creatures. Cards like Winding Way and Lead the Stampede help to refill the hand with creatures to keep the pressure on the opponent. Gingerbread Cabin provides additional mana fixing while Masked Vandal can deal with any troublesome artifacts or enchantments.

With powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, as well as additional support from cards like Wrenn's Resolve and Rally at the Hornburg, this deck aims to close out the game before the opponent has a chance to recover.
